note: Both sets extract the same three Figure 10 scoring thresholds with identical values and supporting quotes, and neither invents or misreads anything. Set A binds the claims to the Contest 10 scoring rules (a sensible component/property pairing) but its condition field merely repeats the variable 'Net electrical energy'. Set B keeps the genuinely important timing condition ('at contest conclusion', per 'at the conclusion of the specified energy balance period') but binds the points thresholds to the entity 'Net electrical energy' rather than to the contest's scoring. These are complementary, roughly equal strengths and weaknesses, so the sets are effectively equivalent in correctness.
